claims.quote: The Sahara toothcarp, Apricaphanius saourensis, is endemic to the Oued Saoura, an endorheic river basin in Algeria that drains into the Sahara.
Endemic to the Oued Saoura river basin in Algeria, an endorheic (closed) drainage that does not run into the ocean but drains into the Sahara Desert and is often dry in its lower reaches.
